items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: we did two sessions for Hammond in 1939

ctx.x: in Norfolk, Virginia, on a blue concert, and everybody wanted to know--nobody had ever heard of her before. And so she announced, I don't know what, but Ernie Fields band did this years ago. What I'm fixing to say is, that it was one of the biggest things we did in thirty nine, but it looked like for some reason they just didn't give it the push that they should have.

I won't blame it all on Hammond; we did two sessions for Hammond in 1939, but I had left--I had a little mishap when I was in New York. Before we left there, we'll get to that, but since we're talking about Melvin, I'd like to say it right now because Melvin was featured on both sessions.
We were going to the Apollo Theatre--
